purpose: Preliminary consolidation of two real published nutrient-release sources for NEXUS kinetic-model exploration.

sources.notes: Two experiments; workbook target column is nitrogen released (%) with outliers already removed by source authors.

sources.source: Environmental Science: Nano supplementary PDF, Table S4
sources.notes: 78 values transcribed from 13 timepoints × 6 UF/MKP formulations; no replicate-level data shown in Table S4.

critical_limitations: These are two studies, with different experimental designs and fertilizer families; preserve paper_id and experiment identifiers.
The UF/MKP supplementary table provides aggregate values without replicate-level uncertainty in Table S4.
Some measurements are extracted from a source workbook with outliers already removed by the source authors.
Curve-fit metrics describe fit to observed curves, not ML prediction on unseen studies.
The 13 NEXUS features and release_constant_k target are not all available in these sources; do not train the existing NEXUS model directly on this combined file.
Do not use the same curve/time observations in both training and test data when evaluating release-curve prediction.
